meta.refined: Extracted, then refined for contrast and consistency. Each refined token's usage says what the source had.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, under the grid and the ambient glow. Site --bg; app AccretionTheme.bg; also the browser theme-color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sections, dialogs, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, active nav item, code and URL wells, icon placeholders, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and sections, and dividers between rows. Decorative only (about 1.3:1); never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Refined (new): the border of text inputs, the search field, selects and segmented choices, at least 3:1 on bg, surface and raised. The source used line (1.3:1) for these.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and raised (15:1 or more). Also the fill of a selected chip and of the toast.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: developer names, meta lines, mono labels, counts, placeholders. 5.2:1 or more on bg, surface and raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand violet: hover and focus borders, the selected tab underline, the ambient glow, chart areas, the start of the headline gradient. For text use accent-text; under white text use accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Refined (new): violet as text (Core and Mod badges, a hovered row name, the More ways icon) on the surfaces and on accent tints up to 16%. The source used accent, which drops to 3.6:1 on its badge tint in dark.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Refined (new): start of the primary button gradient and the sign-guide step number, under on-accent text. In dark the source's accent gave white text 4.2:1; this gives 5.1:1.

tokens.name: accent-fill-end
tokens.usage: End of the primary button gradient (135deg from accent-fill). The source mixed accent 55% with accent-2: #5c93f2 in dark (white 3.0:1, refined) and #4568c8 in light (kept).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill, accent-fill-end and rose-fill.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Cyan, the second brand hue: focus rings (2px, offset 2px), chart lines and dots, the cool half of the ambient glow. A mark colour; for text use link.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Refined (new): links, version numbers in meta lines, Hot badges, form messages. In light the source's accent-2 was 3.5:1 on bg; this is 4.5:1 or more on every ground and on its 14% badge tint.

tokens.name: headline-end
tokens.usage: Far end of the headline and stat-number text gradient (fg at 30%, then this). The app's precomputed colour-mix of accent 70% and accent-2. 5.5:1 or more on bg.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Working, saved, liked, New badges, the live dot, the fits-my-iOS toggle. Always with a word or icon. Light refined from #078a5e (4.1:1 on bg, 3.5:1 on its badge tint).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Behind or needs attention: a stale index, hidden posts, moderator actions, warning lines. Light refined from #b76a00 (3.9:1 on bg).

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Down or failed: the live dot when the index is over a day old, failed checks. Light refined from #c2410c (fails on its badge tint).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Refined (new; the source hard-codes #f43f5e): support heart, liked state, Supporter and Admin badges, destructive-button text and borders. 4.5:1 or more on the surfaces and its 14% tint.

tokens.name: rose-fill
tokens.usage: Refined (new): the unread-notification count bubble, under on-accent text (4.7:1). The source's #f43f5e gave white 3.7:1.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars. Light refined from #f5b83b (1.8:1 on white); an empty star uses line-strong.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The page's faint 1px grid every grid-pitch, drawn under the glow.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Ambient violet light at 30% 25% of the page (radius 42vmax, fading out by 70%). The source's --glow: 16% dark, 9% light.

tokens.name: glow-accent-2
tokens.usage: Ambient cyan light at 75% 70% (radius 36vmax), 0.7 times the violet glow.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modal dialogs, with a 4px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: qr-plate
tokens.usage: QR code plate, white in both themes so scanners read it.

tokens.name: qr-ink
tokens.usage: The caption under a QR code on qr-plate (10:1).

tokens.name: avatar-violet
tokens.usage: Avatar colour a person can pick (one of eight in social.js COLORS). Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-cyan
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-green
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-amber
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-rose
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-blue
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-pink
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-lime
tokens.usage: Avatar colour choice. Initials in avatar-ink.

tokens.name: avatar-ink
tokens.usage: Refined (new): avatar initials, 4.5:1 or more on all eight avatar colours. The source set white initials with a text shadow, 1.5:1 to 4.2:1.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: The home hero only, in the fg-to-headline-end gradient. Scales from 28px on phones (clamp 28px, 4.6vw, 46px); up to 58px on desktop.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: A view's title (Sources, Support, Status, a profile). 26px on phones.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: The app name in an app page header. 22px on phones.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tile numbers, with tabular figures. The hero tiles use 26px.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Shelf headings, All apps, dialog titles, empty-state titles.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Headings inside forms, documents and the download screen.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name beside the icon in the top bar.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Apps from 160+ public AltStore and SideStore sources, merged and cleaned.
styles.usage: The hero paragraph on desktop, in muted, at most 44ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: One entry per app, always the newest version.
styles.usage: All running text. The page's base size.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: App names in rows and cards, source names, fact values. Refined: the site mixes 600 and 650; the app uses semibold.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, nav links, tabs. Compact buttons use 13px.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Developer names, footer text, timestamps, helper lines.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: section headings, stat and fact labels (10.5px on facts). Always uppercase, in muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase line above the headline, next to the live dot; form labels.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Meta lines under app names, result counts, axis labels. Refined: card meta was 11.5px.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Badge text, uppercase. Refined: the site asks for 600, but it loads only 400 and 500, so browsers fake the bold; the app already uses 500.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Source URLs, download keys, permission names, wallet addresses.

styles.name: rank
styles.usage: The rank number at the start of a shelf row, in muted.

spacing.note: Refined into one scale. The site's 13px card padding, 18px section padding and 22px panel padding stay exact in the components; new work takes the nearest step.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a name and its meta line; star padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links and post actions.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and chips; shelf heading margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, buttons in a row, list items.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles and fact cells; section heading margin.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap in the top bar, in rows, in grids; list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Button side padding; dialog content gap.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page side padding on phones; section vertical padding; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Form card padding; gap in an app header.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero column gap; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Column gap between shelves; the grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page side padding on wide screens; footer padding.

radius.note: Refined: the site uses 15 different radii (5 to 26px). They group into these steps; icons scale with their size.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges and keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls: shelf arrows, nav links, post actions, the brand icon, install-way icons (source 6 to 9px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, the search field (source 11px), toasts, URL wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, fact cells, list rows, segmented choices.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: App cards and sections. The source's single --radius token.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Large panels: app page header, dialogs, profile and form cards (source 16 to 18px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, count pills, feature tags.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icons at any size (60px gives 14px, 112px gives 26px), matching the iOS icon shape the site approximates.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Home and footer width; shelves fill 1 to 4 columns.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Views and app pages.

tokens.name: prose-max
tokens.usage: Rules, privacy and guide pages.

tokens.name: form-max
tokens.usage: Form cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a button.

tokens.name: tap-compact
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a compact button.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Spacing of the background grid lines.

tokens.name: card-min
tokens.usage: Minimum app card width in the All apps grid.

tokens.name: shelf-min
tokens.usage: Minimum shelf column width.

tokens.name: icon-chip
tokens.usage: App icon inside an app chip.

tokens.name: icon-row
tokens.usage: App icon in a shelf row.

tokens.name: icon-card
tokens.usage: App icon in an app card.

tokens.name: icon-hero
tokens.usage: App icon in an app page header (80px under 760px wide).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-hidden
tokens.usage: Posts hidden by a moderator, and the icon of an app with no working download (with grayscale).

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: A button while pressed (app), with scale 0.96.
